data.notes: Confirmed December music programming is concentrated in Paznaun ski-opening and après-style events rather than a December Top of the Mountain concert.

events.title: Electronic Dias Kappl
events.venueName: Roof terrace at Sunny Mountain, Kappl ski resort
events.summary: High-altitude electronic day party in the Paznaun-Ischgl area with Tiffany Seguí, Pvssycat, Marvin Aloys, Karotte and Sante Sansone; free admission with a valid ski pass, gondola open late until 19:00.

events.title: Galtür Ski Opening
events.summary: Radio Ramasuri / Radio Galaxy Ski Opening 2026 runs 4–6 December in nearby Galtür, with live music from Boazn Briada, hut-sound programming, and a Saturday opening party with a live band at Huberstadl.

events.title: Freeride Après Clubbing – Winter 2026/27 Residency
events.summary: Daily winter après-clubbing residency running through the 2026/27 season, with DJs every afternoon heating the dancefloor from 13:00 into the late-night window.

events.title: Bad Medicine - Bon Jovi Tribute Band in Kappl
events.summary: Bad Medicine perform Bon Jovi hits live on 12 December as the music component of the Skischaukel Kappl & See opening event near Ischgl.

events.title: Kuhstall Daily DJ Après-Ski Residency – Winter 2026/27
events.summary: Long-running Ischgl après-ski party institution with daily winter opening, DJs, dancing and high-energy pop/dance entertainment through the December ski-season period.

events.title: Top of the Mountain Opening Concert
events.summary: Ischgl’s official Top of the Mountain Opening Concert is confirmed for 28 November 2026, kicking off the winter season with a major live act still to be announced by the organizer.
